items.text: David Montgomery (groin) removed from injury report after full practices; expected to play TNF vs Colts. Woody Marks (concussion) ruled out.
items.why: Full practices short week; Marks out opens three-down role.
items.implication: RB2/flex restart vs soft Colts front; volume spike.
items.opportunity: Majority of HOU RB snaps/carries/redzone with Marks out.

items.text: Andy Reid on Kenneth Walker (groin): sore last week, getting better, but 'don't want to do something stupid.' Levitan agrees playing him less than 100% is stupid, especially with huge Week 12 at BUF; Chiefs 15.5-pt favorites vs ARI.
items.why: Reid comments + DNP Wed; short-term rehab priority over this matchup.
items.implication: High risk of another sit; monitor practice/Fri designation closely.
items.opportunity: Lead back role intact if active; Emmett Johnson continues smash if out.

items.text: Wan'Dale Robinson will miss the rest of the season.
items.why: Injury forces rest of season miss.

items.text: Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield did not practice Wednesday due to a foot injury.
items.why: Foot strain; Rapoport notes trending toward missing vs Lions.
items.implication: Rookie likely to start again; impacts TB pass catchers/ dual-threat.

items.text: No IR for Jordan Addison per coach Kevin O’Connell after thumb surgery.
items.implication: Misses near-term but rosterable ROS; Jefferson volume boost short-term.

items.text: Colts ruled out TE Will Mallory, OT Bernhard Raimann, DT Jerry Tillery, OT Jalen Travis and CB Charvarius Ward for TNF vs Texans. Sauce Gardner questionable.
items.why: Multiple injuries confirmed for short week.
items.implication: OL/DB thin; boosts HOU run/pass efficiency.

items.text: Brock Bowers (ankle) DNP Wednesday, remains day-to-day; coach says significant but not as bad as thought, doesn't need practice to play.
items.why: Ankle from Week 10; multiple return attempts failed then.
items.implication: TE1 if active vs DEN; Mayer streams if out.
items.opportunity: High target share intact with Mendoza if healthy.

items.text: NE loses Drake Maye, potentially for the season (ankle); team-by-team negatives post-Maye noted.
items.why: Significant lower leg/ankle; bye then uncertain.
items.implication: NE offense downgrade ROS; hard negatives on skill players.

items.text: Up in pace: TEN @ DAL. Slow paced slogs: MIA @ BUF. Full Week 11 Snaps & Pace from Pat Thorman.
items.why: TEN hurry-up/no-huddle surge + DAL high play volume; MIA-BUF slow.
items.implication: Volume boost for TEN/DAL skill; suppress MIA/BUF.

items.text: DeVonta Smith returned to practice and 'felt good'; trending toward return.
items.why: Felt good on return to practice.
items.implication: Likely active; PHI WR depth stabilizes.

items.text: Coke heads, I’m sorry. I am CLOSING IT OUT on Jalen Coker. The talent is there. The fantasy production has not been.
items.why: Talent vs lack of fantasy production.

items.text: I am CLOSING IT OUT on Jaylen Waddle. The target share is nice. The production is not.
items.why: Full practice post-concussion but production lagging targets.
items.implication: Sit/flex down; close out in shallow leagues.
items.conflict: Full participant Wed but Berry production-focused.

items.text: FULL CHUB(A) FOR MR. HUBBARD! Chuba Hubbard is my RB6 in rest-of-season rankings.
items.implication: Start every week; RB1/2 ROS value.

items.text: Omarion Hampton finally got lead-back volume: 22 carries, 105 yards, a touchdown, and 63% of the snaps. With six teams on bye, he’s a start against the Jets.
items.implication: Start vs Jets; role expansion sticky.
